request.subject: UNIT:CULT:CATAPULT

layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.
layers.negative: photorealism, painterly brushwork, gradients, dithering, noise, tiny details, thin outline, low-poly 3D, faceted polygons, blur, text, letters, numbers, logo, UI, frame, health bar, selection ring, cropped subject

layers.text: Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Faction: a pulp-magazine secret society of the 1920s, sinister, grim and evil, not cute. Their colours: ceremonial cloth of black and charcoal with deep blood-red linings, sashes and trim, embroidered with tarnished gold occult sigils; dull brass; pale cream candle wax and parchment; bright red fresh blood on blades; and one small accent, a glowing spring green, only as candle flames and sparks.

layers.text: Class: one chunky cute unit figure with a big head, short sturdy body and one oversized signature weapon or tool, thick single-colour black outline, standing ready pose, both feet visible; the feet are the lowest thing in the image.

layers.text: Subject: Stargazer, a crooked old astrologer of an evil secret society at a big brass telescope: a long charcoal-black robe embroidered with gold stars and a black hood lined with blood red; his wrinkled pale face is pressed to the eyepiece of one fat polished brass telescope on a wooden tripod, the tube pointing up to the right; a cream star chart scroll trails on the ground; the telescope glass is dark, not glowing; simple shapes and very few details.
The group is drawn large: about 64 pixels wide and 74 pixels tall. The telescope is polished yellow brass and is the biggest thing in the image. The old man's human face with skin shows.
